thread:
Priya Patel: Quick pulse-check — we’re green to publish the release announcement tomorrow 10:00am PT, right? Need final changelog URL + docs link for the social copy and the landing page.
Jordan Lee: Working on the changelog now. Will push the final md to the repo in ~30m. Can we ship with canary at 10:30?
Alex Chen: Product is fine with 10:30 canary. We should pause automated canary ramp at 11:15 if any errors.
Maya Singh: Docs: I’ve got the how-to and API examples ready. Docs preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/release-2024-06. Will add redirect to /docs/release-notes once prod link is live.
Samir Khan: SRE: canary schedule ok for us. I’ll open a temporary maintenance window 10:25–11:45 and attach the runbook. Also putting a short alert for latency increases >20%.
Lena Torres: Webinar folks — we still plan to run the post-launch 30-min quick demo at 1pm PT. Marketing needs a 1-2 line benchmark headline for the slide: something punchy about latency/cost.
Jordan Lee: Bench headline draft: “Redwood inference: 2× lower p99 latency at 50k requests/day vs baseline, 35% lower per-token cost with cache + batching.” Short, but accurate.
Priya Patel: Perfect. Can you give a one-sentence supporting stat we can cite in the blog? Needs to be non-technical.
Jordan Lee: Sure: "Observed median response time of ~120ms on common chat workloads with default batching and prefix caching enabled (internal perf test)."
Eliot Park: Copy request — please confirm changelog entry (we’ll paste into the announcement):
```
- Release 2024-06-22: streaming responses, improved KV cache persistence, configurable canary rollouts. See full changelog: <TBD link>
```
Priya Patel: Maya, once you flip the redirect, can you post the final docs link here? We'll update the announcement draft.
Maya Singh: Will do. I’ll post prod link here as soon as redirect is live. ETA 20m.
Alex Chen: Tiny ask from Prod — can we include an ops note for Dedicated customers about planned rolling restarts in the release notes? One short sentence.
Priya Patel: Yes, add: "Dedicated clusters may experience brief rolling restarts; no data loss expected." Good?
Samir Khan: Fine. Also adding a note in runbook: watch gateway error rate and GPU memory spikes.
Lena Torres: For the landing page: can marketing get a single canonical gif of the product in action? Need by 6pm PT today.
Jordan Lee: I can export a short 6s gif of the chat flow with streaming. Will drop to the assets bucket by 4:30pm.
Priya Patel: Last coordination: embargo? Are we going live with press at 10am PT or holding until 10:30 canary success?
Alex Chen: Hold press until canary shows no high-severity errors for 30m. So press embargo lift at 11:00 PT.
Priya Patel: Noted. Team — I’ll queue the announce post, landing page, and social assets. Will paste final changelog+docs link here when available, then we'll do a quick convo sign-off at 9:50am PT. :thumbsup: :party:
Maya Singh: PROD docs live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/2024-06-22 (changelog link embedded).
Eliot Park: Copied into the announcement draft and updated the blog YAML with the docs link.
Priya Patel: Final check: who’s on the release day rota? Jordan, Samir, Maya, Alex?
Jordan Lee: I’ll be on infra for the first hour.
Samir Khan: On-call for SRE.
Maya Singh: Docs watch — will monitor comments and fix typos live.
Alex Chen: Product standby.
Lena Torres: Marketing here for comms and webinar host.
Priya Patel: Great — closing thread. See you at the 9:50 sign-off.
Jordan Lee: Thanks all.
Samir Khan: 👍
Priya Patel: (thread closed)
